metas.name: Pluribus
metas.description: In a world overtaken by a mysterious wave of forced happiness, Carol Sturka, one of the immune few, must uncover what's really going on - and save humanity from its artificial bliss.

metas.name: The Chair Company
metas.description: Tim Robinson stars as Ron, a family man who investigates a conspiracy after an embarrassing incident at work.

metas.name: Alien: Earth
metas.description: When a mysterious space vessel crash-lands on Earth, a young woman and a ragtag group of tactical soldiers make a fateful discovery that puts them face-to-face with the planet's greatest threat.

metas.name: Heated Rivalry
metas.description: Two rival hockey stars at the top of their game face an unexpected challenge when they develop feelings for each other, complicating their careers and the sport's expectations.

metas.name: The Terror
metas.description: Supernatural, semihistorical horror anthology series, where each season is inspired by a different infamous or mysterious real-life historical tragedy.

metas.name: Channel Zero
metas.description: An anthology series based on creepypastas.

metas.name: Crystal Lake
metas.description: Prequel series to Friday the 13th, follows a doomed small town where camp counselors come to die.

metas.name: Undone
metas.description: After she very narrowly survives a serious car accident, a woman discovers that she has a new relationship with time.

metas.name: The OA
metas.description: Having gone missing seven years ago, the previously blind Prairie returns home, now in her twenties with her sight restored. While many believe she is a miracle, others worry that she could be dangerous.

metas.name: Los Espookys
metas.description: A group of friends turns their love for horror into a peculiar business, providing horror to those who need it in a dreamy Latin American country where the strange and eerie are just part of daily life.

metas.name: Get Jiro!
metas.description: In a future LA controlled by elite chefs, a sushi master named Jiro gets embroiled in a vicious culinary conflict, seeking vengeance through his cooking skills amidst the cutthroat restaurant scene.

metas.name: It: Welcome to Derry
metas.description: In 1962, a couple with their son move to Derry, Maine just as a young boy disappears. With their arrival, very bad things begin to happen in the town.

metas.name: The Boulet Brothers' Dragula
metas.description: Extreme drag artists from around the world compete in challenges including costume design and creation, makeup and special effects, live performance, and craftsmanship.

metas.name: The Pet Cemetery Murders: A Ghost Story
metas.description: The re-opening of a mysterious 1985 cold case murder in Louisiana unearths a haunting history of bloodshed and long-buried trauma.

metas.name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
metas.description: Thirty volunteers enter a real prison facility and are randomly assigned roles as guards or prisoners to test whether ordinary people conform to assigned power dynamics or maintain their empathy and individuality.

metas.name: The Diplomat
metas.description: In the midst of an international crisis, Kate Wyler, a career diplomat, lands in a high-profile job for which she is not suited, with tectonic implications for her marriage and her political future.

metas.name: Nobody Wants This
metas.description: An agnostic sex podcaster and a newly single rabbi fall in love; discovering if their relationship can survive their wildly different lives and meddling families.

metas.name: Veneno
metas.description: A biographical story of TV personality and transgender icon La Veneno and those who surrounded her.

metas.name: 30 Coins
metas.description: An exiled priest tries to escape his demons while living in a remote village in Spain.

metas.name: Marianne
metas.description: When a famous horror writer goes back to her hometown, she finds out that the evil spirit that plagues her dreams is also there in real life.

metas.name: Kaiba
metas.description: In a futuristic dystopian world where memories are literally stored, bought and sold and rich have all the privileges, a young amnesiac is trying to find out who he is.

metas.name: Sonny Boy
metas.description: A group of students on summer vacation find themselves transported to another dimension and granted superpowers to survive there.

metas.name: The Shivering Truth
metas.description: A miniature propellant cluster bomb of painfully mutinous nightmares, all dripping with the orange sludge of dream logic.

metas.name: Tales of the City
metas.description: 1976. Mary Ann Singleton is a young secretary from Cleveland who takes a vacation to San Francisco and decides to stay. Through her eyes the story depicts the city at the height of its boisterous gay, drug, and disco cultures.

metas.name: Quarry
metas.description: Quarry, a disillusioned Vietnam War vet, returns home to Memphis in 1972 only to find rejection and scrutiny at every step. A mysterious man known only as The Broker gives him an offer he can't refuse - to work for him as a hitman.

metas.name: The Kingdom
metas.description: Doctors at an ultramodern hospital in Denmark become convinced, by way of weird, inexplicable happenings, that the place is haunted.
